summary: F7/F10/F11 reported cases pass; F8 retains a reproducible concurrency defect. Project checks pass. Records updated; no commit.

findings.explanation: The consumer validates an already-loaded supply point, then unconditionally saves registered state. If another worker delivers the old outcome and a new transfer starts after that read, the stale delivery incorrectly registers the new transfer. The expanded probe reproduces this. Make correlation validation and mutation atomic against current database state.
